perturbation_system: in vivo VSV-vectored HIV vaccination; not CRISPR

confirmatory_family.family_status: closed; any later candidate requires a newly declared alpha-spending family
confirmatory_family.directional_endpoint_rule: Each two-sided 95% interval endpoint is a one-sided alpha 0.025 test; Bonferroni over two fixed candidates controls familywise alpha at 0.05.
confirmatory_family.poki_status: reported separately; not scoreable or promotable because its frozen run produced no inferential test

preseal_source_access: RNA and ADT barcode axes and feature lists were inspected and independently hashed to verify same-cell alignment and freeze aliases; neither RNA nor ADT matrix values were downloaded or opened.
excluded_unit_rule: P6 is excluded because the publication reports pre-vaccine activation and removes it from vaccination-response analysis.
primary_estimand: absolute post-vaccine 3x3 RNA-state by ADT-state tables in each held donor, day, and marginally supported cognate marker-lineage entity
primary_grid: each marginally supported cognate marker-lineage entity by two post-vaccine days by four Helmert coupling coordinates; eight outputs per entity
alias_rule: exact 33-entry one-to-one 5-prime feature mapping; no normalization fallback; reject duplicate ADT features, duplicate gene symbols, missing features, and duplicate RNA rows; exclude ambiguous CD16
state_rule: per-marker-lineage RNA and ADT tertiles fitted only on pooled development-donor day-0 cells in that lineage; exact cuts are applied unchanged; retain an entity only when cuts are distinct and every RNA and ADT state has at least 5% occupancy separately in every development and held donor-day marginal; held joints are never formed for support filtering; require at least 12 unique cognate markers
primary_estimator: equal development-donor mean absolute coupling field; the structured loss uses clipped inverse permutation variance of that mean, a nuclear penalty 0.1 times the largest singular value, a six-external-neighbor scGPT gene hypergraph plus represented-lineage hyperedges, graph penalty 5.0, and tolerance 1e-9
membership_permuted_rule: permute scGPT embedding assignments once at the unique cognate-marker level; preserve every represented-lineage hyperedge exactly
optimizer_reporting: prediction records convergence, iterations, relative step, objective, effective rank, singular values, and realized penalties for every structured fit
destroyed_rule: margin-preserving pairing-destroyed development fields fit with the identical weights, nuclear penalty, hypergraph, graph penalty, and optimizer as the primary
classical_baselines: full 3x3 Pearson independence-residual matrix, direct and identically structured
full 3x3 signed Poisson-deviance independence-residual matrix, direct and identically structured
table_rule: prediction stores no tables and its frozen code path does not use held RNA-ADT pairing; score reconstructs tables from locked coordinates plus held finite-table null means and held margins before invoking held-joint scoring
common_endpoint: multinomial deviance per held cell under identical observed post-vaccine row and column margins
secondary_estimand: day3-minus-day0 and day7-minus-day0 coupling-field correlation; descriptive only and excluded from promotion
primary_gate: pooled held coupling-field correlation complete-marker bootstrap 95% CI lower endpoint greater than zero
positive coupling-field correlation in every held donor
primary-minus-identically-structured-destroyed per-cell deviance marker-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint below zero
primary-minus-best-classical per-cell deviance marker-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint below zero, reselecting the best classical method within each draw
primary-minus-best-matched per-cell deviance marker-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint below zero, reselecting the best matched method within each draw
no source-integrity, support, reconstruction, margin, or optimization refusal
bootstrap_unit: cognate marker cluster retaining every supported lineage-pair entity; inference is conditional on deposited held donors P5, P3, and P2
public_verification_requirement: Before access, independently fresh-clone the candidate-freeze commit and verify the exact disabled designation and every bound artifact byte-for-byte. Before scoring, fresh-clone and verify the prediction and authorization artifacts and confirm that the authorization commit descends from the prediction commit. Release the verification record.
